Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the web results that explicitly associated Handi-Snacks with Mondelez/Nabisco (e.g., Snackworks page referencing Mondelez and retailer listings labeled “Mondelez”) and incorrectly concluded the brand is sold by The Kraft Heinz Company. This reflects a misclassification of current brand ownership—confusing legacy Kraft associations post-2012 split—and a premature task completion without reconciling the evidence indicating Mondelez International.
